notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.10.4 (September 9)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627173/e4e48867f59074428d1a3b9106779bb2f64188d9.png"]
Powerups
Ball returns to owner if it hasn't been hit in a while

Ball now looks like a watermelon

Ball damage has been greatly increased

Bounce now visually changes in size when splitting to better reflect damage dealt

Cupid Arrows damage has been increased

Jeweled Boomerang is now affected by Fire Rate

Tarot Cards level 3 has been changed to an additional card. Fire rate increased has been removed.

Tarot Cards signature fire rate has been reduced
Charms
\[NEW] Haste

Added new icons for Ultimate Cooldown, Powerup Critical, Critical Boost, Haste, and Fire Rate
UI / HUD
Upgrade UI has been reworked.

Now shows if a powerup if affected by Fire Rate, Haste, or Critical

Different colors for powerup and charm cards

\[NEW] Press F1 to view your current powerups and charms

Multiplayer pointers now render on top of other UI

Bosses and minibosses now have pointers

Screen now turns gray while dead

An icon now appears next to the Shop button when you are able to purchase rerolls

Ultimate icon is slightly animated when it is ready to cast
Settings
Added cursor size setting

Add visible hitbox toggle
Bosses / Minibosses
Minibosses are now immune to knockback

Corvus circle attacks are now easier to see

Andromeda scream attack warning duration has been increased
Bugfixes
"Artifact Reroll" has been correctly named to "Charm Reroll"

Charm Reroll is now disabled if player already has 3 charms

Player sprites no longer animate while game is paused

No longer returns to an outdated shop when returning from a game

Fixed first frame of Amber's idle animation glitching out

Fixed bug where some powerups dealt incorrect damage at max level (sorry)

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.10.0 (September 3)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45627173/6f444596eb151a8ed38a0ebf78e907f39e0ba7c3.png"]NEW MAP
A new map, "Desert", has been added. The starting map has been named to "Valley". To unlock Desert, you must complete the Valley map.

Desert's release includes new dialogue.
NEW CHARACTER
A new character, "Amber", has been added.

Amber's release includes new dialogue.
NEW CHARMS
Critical Chance: One of your powerups can now critically hit. The specific powerup is named in the upgrade. The specific powerup changes each time this charm is rolled.

Critical Boost: Increases critical chance and critical damage of your powerups. (This can only be rolled if you already own at least one powerup that can critically hit or the Critical Chance charm)

Fire Rate: Increases the fire rate of projectiles (Bubble Pop, Bounce, Cupid Arrows, Heartbeat Burst, Marble Slingshot, Tarot Cards, Turret)

Critical Ultimate has been removed.
NEW POWERUP: BALL
Ball (Multiplayer-exclusive): Ball.
Powerup Reworks and Adjustments
Damage indicators are now blue when a critical hit has been made.
Pulse
Pulse has been changed to be a Multiplayer-exclusive powerup.

Pulse can spread to nearby allies, increasing its damage.

Pulse can no longer knockback enemies
Bubble Pop
Bubble Pop now travels in a straight line toward a random enemy. 

Bubble Pop damages enemies along the way and critically hits when it pops.
Bounce
Bounce now splits into more projectiles when hitting an enemy. (Can only split as many times as it can bounce)

Bounce speed increased

Bounce visual size increased
Ribbon
At level 3, Ribbon now has infinite length
Fan
Fan hitbox has been updated to be more consistent in applying knockback.

Fan knockback now scales with player speed
Minibosses Rework
Minibosses no longer drop powerups. Instead, once they are defeated, everyone may choose a powerup or powerup upgrade.

Now drops lots of EXP and gold

Once defeated, game timer progresses twice as fast.
Bosses
Corvus hitbox has been increased

Corvus speed has been increased

Bosses now spawn additional enemies
Shop
Added Powerup Rerolls and Charm Rerolls to the Shop
Lobby
New visuals
Settings
Can now change the opacity of ally powerups (This does not affect multiplayer powerups or other powerups that you can interact with, such as Puddle)

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.9.0 (July 13)
notes.content:
NEW Dialogue
Dialogue will now appear at the start of the game. The specific conversation depends on the characters you are playing.
NEW Powerups
Additional powerups have been added: 

Bounce: Shoot a projectile that bounces between enemies

Fan: Shoot a gust of wind in front of you, damaging and pushing back enemies.

Puddle: Create damaging puddles. When stepped on, puddles splash and deal burst damage.

Pulse: Create a shockwave that damages and pushes back enemies.

Turret: Create turrets that shoot enemies within range.

Painted Lady (Multiplayer-Exclusive): Paints a damaging line from you to your farthest ally

Lightning (Multiplayer-Exclusive): Shoot a bolt of lightning to all allies, enemies hit will spread lightning arcs.

All powerups have a level 3 upgrade (including Ribbon, which previously did not have one) 

Sound effects and proper names will be added in the future.
Lobby Features
Steam friends can now be directly invited through the lobby by clicking on the portal

Lobby hosts can now kick out players

Lobby list now automatically refreshes every few seconds

Lobby list now has a loading icon

Lobby list now estimates ping

"No internet connection" message appears if failed to connect

In progress games cannot be joined and are grayed out
Bug Fixes
Character sprites now animate correctly in multiplayer

Goth now has a death animation

Bushes no longer spawn in lakes

Vale signature drones now appear correctly in multiplayer

Gold now correctly updates in the Shop

Reroll button now correctly updates in multiplayer

Outdated powerup descriptions have been fixed

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.8.0 (June 22)
notes.content:
NEW Charms
Stat upgrades have been replaced with charms. Players may hold up to 3 charms.

Golden Hour: Decreases the chance of getting nothing from defeating an enemy. After reaching max level, enemies will only drop gold. (Limited to 1 player per game)

Hearty: Increases max health by 20. The first time your health reaches 0, stay at 1 HP and gain a 50 HP temporary shield.

Magnetic Aura: No longer attract EXP and Gold when you go near them. Instead, collect all EXP and Gold on the field every minute. (Limited to 1 player per game)

Health Regen: Gradually restore health over time.

Speed Boost: Increase your speed.

Ultimate Cooldown: Reduces the cooldown of your ultimate by half.

Ultimate Critical: Your ultimate ability has a random chance to critically hit for more damage.
NEW Multiplayer Powerups
Two multiplayer-exclusive powerups have been added. On level up, players have a chance to roll a fourth upgrade option, which will hold a multiplayer-exclusive powerup. 

Ribbon: Connect a ribbon between you and and the nearest player.

Shuttle Shuffle: Bounces between players, dealing damage and shielding based on distance traveled.
Level 3 Upgrade Adjustments
The following powerups have had their level 3 upgrade changed:

Bubble Pop: Adds 2 bubbles

Jeweled Boomerang: Adds two boomerangs

Mr. Bee: Taunt removed from earlier levels. Taunt now added at level 3.

Star Prism Power: Adds a second star
Other Changes & Bug Fixes
Added "Connecting..." screen when loading into a lobby

Enemies now move smoothly around lakes

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.6.1 (June 8)
notes.content:
NEW Shop
The Shop button is now available! Currently only rerolls can be bought in the shop.
Players no longer start with 3 rerolls, and can now buy up to 5 rerolls from the shop.
You can access the shop from both the main menu and the lobby.

NEW General Settings
The Settings button is now available! Currently the following settings are available:

 Screen Mode (Windowed or Fullscreen)
 Music Volume
 Sound Effects Volume

Note: There are known bugs with some sound effect audio not being affected by the volume setting.

NEW Lobby Settings
Lobbies can now be set to "Public", "Friends Only", or "Private".

NEW Main Menu and Battle Music
With the addition of the Settings menu, background music has also been added.

Gameplay Updates
All powerup damage values and enemy health values have been updated. Previously, early mid game was very difficult, and late game was very easy. Values have been adjusted in an attempt to somewhat even out the pacing of the game.

Level 3 Upgrades
All items now have level 3 upgrades that add additional power other than damage.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.5.0 (June 4)
notes.content:
Gameplay Updates
Cupid Arrows:

 Now targets the nearest enemy
 Reduced damage

Laser:

 Decreased Laser scaling damage
 Signature: Drone lasers have been moved closer to the player

Amore Dove Ultimate:

 Ultimate now additionally slows down enemies

NEW Vale Ultimate:

 After activating, click to launch up to 3 missiles at your cursor location that deal damage in a large explosion
 Missile visual is currently the same as Bubble Pop

Goth Ultimate:

 Increased time that enemy-turned-allies are alive


Upon death, you can spectate other players' POVs by using the A and D keys.

Ability Sound Effects
The following abilities have new sound effects:

 Bubble Pop
 Cupid Arrows
 Firework Flora
 Heartbeat Burst
 Jeweled Boomerang
 Marble Slingshot
 Mr. Bee
 Nature's Path
 Star Prism Power


Visual Updates
The following abilities have slightly updated visual effects:

 Cupid Arrows
 Firework Flora
 Star Prism Power
 Amore Dove Ultimate

Corvus (final boss) attack sprites have also been updated.

Damage number indicators have been replaced by hit markers. Players and enemies now glow red when taking damage.
Character icons and arrows that point towards allies have been added during multiplayer. When a player dies, these turn gray.

You can now see allies' health bars.

A new default mouse cursor has been added.

New ultimate icons have been added for Sweet, Vale, and Amore Dove.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed overlapping main menu buttons when returning to menu
 Characters can no longer pick up health when they're at full health
 Corvus bullets can no longer be destroyed by player abilities
 Laser now correctly damages bushes
 Bushes no longer spawn on top of players
 Game now pauses during game over screen
 Third player in lobby no longer renders on top of "Start Game"
 Fixed bug where a giant animated character sprite appeared in the center of the map during lag or when someone left the game

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.4.0 (May 23)
notes.content:
Signature & Level 3 Changes
The following abilities have had their signatures reworked and have an additional perk when unlocking level 3.

Scythe

 At level 3, Scythe becomes double-sided (attacks from both front and back)
 At signature, Scythe becomes larger and hits 3 times

Laser

 At level 3, Laser pierces through enemies
 At signature, two additional Lasers are added

Cupid Arrows

 At level 3, additional arrows are added
 At signature, an additional volley is added per side


Other

 Version number is now visible from the main menu
